normalizations.text: Bytes become { sha256, length }, sha256 as lowercase hex.
The result of documents.delete becomes null.
A descriptor becomes the fields of sdk-specification.md §7.1 only, without helper methods; other response fields are dropped.

retryRules.text: An HTTP 429 answer is retried, except the codes of R-NONRETRY.
Any other 4xx answer is not retried.
QUOTA_EXCEEDED, OVERAGE_CAP_EXCEEDED and STORAGE_ACCESS_DENIED are never retried.
aborted is never retried, and a cancellation during a sleep ends it at once.
The presigned-URL download is not retried.
A Retry-After header in integer seconds sets the delay before the next attempt, without jitter.
A Retry-After header in HTTP-date form sets the delay to the time left until that date.
The Retry-After delay is clamped to 0-30 s.
With no Retry-After, the delay before retry n (1-based) is retryDelay x 2^(n-1) x j, with j uniform in [0.5, 1.5).
A call makes at most 1 + maxRetries attempts; the last error is thrown.
Every attempt of one call sends the same Idempotency-Key, a UUID v4.
